protocol: ANMP version v1, radio flows of the patron (ADR 0051, ADR 0054 §3a, §4)
comment: Flows of a patron (ADR 0051 §5, §5a, §6; ADR 0054 §4), written by kotlin/core RadioFlowVectorsTest (UPDATE_VECTORS=1) through RadioRelay and played by go/anmp patron_test.go. Times: start + t in milliseconds, inbox ts in Unix seconds. Each step first lets the time run to t (offers whose wait ends at or before t go out), then takes its input: inbox (entries put into the radio inbox, read only with the next pickup or serve), ask (heard through gateway, measured hops or null, SNR or null, the random part jitterMs of the wait and the one-time key patronKey (X25519 private) the patron draws for it), patron (heard another patron), pickup (heard), serve (the patron reads the radio inbox and serves its patronages). send: packets that went out in the step, in order, with hop limit (null: the radio's own) and gateway (null: the app's radio). limits: packets held back, patronage (perHour per patronage) or gateway (perGatewayHour over all patronages; also an offer not sent because the budget of its gateway is used up). A packet goes to the same asker (sender tag of the pickup) at most once an hour, across patronages. Wait before an offer: waitMin + (waitMax − waitMin) × clamp((5 − SNR) / 20, 0, 1) in float32, truncated, + jitterMs; SNR null counts as −15. Patron packets are open packets with from = patronFrom.

flows.name: app: patron delivers the last 30 days
